userGuide.hero.title: User Guide
userGuide.hero.subtitle: Learn how to use the ASEZA portal step by step — from login to submitting your first request.
userGuide.tour.title: Try the Interactive Tour
userGuide.tour.subtitle: Let us guide you step by step through the app — faster than reading the guide!
userGuide.step.label: Step {{number}}
userGuide.tips.title: Helpful Tips
userGuide.cta.title: You're ready to submit your first request!
userGuide.cta.subtitle: If you run into any issues, you can return to this guide at any time or launch the interactive tour from the lightbulb icon in the navigation bar.
userGuide.steps.login.title: Sign In
userGuide.steps.login.description: Open the app and the login screen will appear. Click the "Sign in with ASEZA account" button and you will be automatically redirected to the Microsoft page to enter your institutional credentials.
userGuide.steps.login.tip2: Your session is saved automatically — no need to sign in every time
userGuide.steps.login.tip3: If your session expires, the system will redirect you to the login page
userGuide.steps.home.title: Home Dashboard
userGuide.steps.home.description: After signing in you'll land on the main dashboard. It shows the total number of your requests. Your 5 most recent submissions also appear in a quick table, with Quick Actions beside it.
userGuide.steps.home.tip1: The total is refreshed automatically from the server on every visit
userGuide.steps.home.tip2: Click "View All" to navigate to the My Requests page
userGuide.steps.home.tip3: Data Entry users can start a new request from the "Quick Actions" card
userGuide.steps.requests.title: My Requests
userGuide.steps.requests.description: This page lists all your submissions with the reference number, KPI form, KPI count, dates, and status. You can paginate through results and refresh the list.
userGuide.steps.requests.tip1: Click a row or the view icon to open the full details of any request
userGuide.steps.requests.tip2: You can export request details as a Word file (DOCX)
userGuide.steps.requests.tip3: Request statuses: Draft, Submitted, Approved, Rejected, Returned
userGuide.steps.newRequest.title: Create a New Request
userGuide.steps.newRequest.description: Click "Add New Request" on the My Requests page. The KPI form assigned to your directorate opens immediately with the active reporting period.
userGuide.steps.newRequest.tip1: The button is only visible to users with the "Data Entry" role
userGuide.steps.newRequest.tip2: You cannot advance to the next page until all required fields are filled
userGuide.steps.newRequest.tip3: The sidebar displays the form name, directorate, reporting period, and completion progress
userGuide.steps.fillSteps.title: Fill in the Steps
userGuide.steps.fillSteps.description: The form is divided into data pages, then a Review & Confirm step. Each page contains fields such as text, numbers, dropdowns, dates, and tables. The top bar shows the current page and the sidebar tracks your completion percentage.
userGuide.steps.fillSteps.tip2: Press "Back" to return to a previous page without losing your data
userGuide.steps.fillSteps.tip3: Values are validated automatically when you press "Next"
userGuide.steps.submit.title: Submit the Request
userGuide.steps.submit.description: On Review & Confirm, verify your values, tick the confirmation box, then press Submit. A confirmation dialog appears on success, then you return to My Requests.
userGuide.steps.submit.tip1: Review all fields carefully before submitting
userGuide.steps.submit.tip2: After submission the request can only be edited if returned by an approver
userGuide.steps.submit.tip3: Track status from Home or My Requests after the request is sent
